caption: The video showcases a macro close-up of an ornate ring shaped like a bow or butterfly against a dark background. Two large pear-shaped transparent faceted stones form the wings, joined by a central cluster of small brilliant diamonds, while pavé-set gold bands extend outward as bow tails and a curved metal shank blurs at the bottom. The ring turns and tilts continuously, its wing axis swinging from a shallow diagonal orientation toward a steep lower-left to upper-right diagonal. As it rotates, the left stone drops into a downward tilt and the right wing rises and changes angle, shifting the blurred shank across the lower area. Star-shaped specular glints and bright facet highlights migrate and intensify across the stones. A strong flare builds on the left wing. The turning motion remains ongoing.
